local function fipro(Obj, Amount, Skip)
    if Obj.ClassName == "ProximityPrompt" then
        Amount = Amount or 1
        local PromptTime = Obj.HoldDuration
        if Skip then
            Obj.HoldDuration = 0
        end
        for i = 1, Amount do
            Obj:InputHoldBegin()
            if not Skip then
                wait(Obj.HoldDuration)
            end
            Obj:InputHoldEnd()
        end
        Obj.HoldDuration = PromptTime
    else
